When tickets went on sale for the tour, my bestie of 20+ years texted me asking if I wanted to go see BTS with her. She really wanted to go and needed a concert buddy. I had heard their name but wasn't really familiar with them. However, I'm a huge fan of live music and I knew it meant a lot to her. Little did I know almost 3 months later I'd be ARMY, with my life changed because of these 7 men and their music. I like to say I'm starting my 2.0 as a mom finding herself during their 2.0 💟🫰
